move: phone rises, chat bubbles pop in with typing dots, phone drops away
how: On a 1080x1920 dark-green frame a 560x1160 phone rises from y 260, rotate -4, scale 0.92 with 1.1s expo.out while a two-line headline lifts from yPercent 110 (expo.out, 0.08s stagger) and a subline fades. All chat items start autoAlpha 0, scale 0.6, y 20. From 9% each bubble pops to autoAlpha 1, scale 1, y 0 with 0.45s back.out(1.8); before every incoming bubble a typing indicator is positioned at that bubble's offsetTop, pops in with back.out(2), its three dots bounce y -6 in a staggered yoyo for 0.7s, then it shrinks away; before every outgoing bubble the send button pulses scale 1.25 yoyo. Cadence is 0.6s after incoming and 0.8s after outgoing, and the header status flips to 'typing…' then 'online'. The phone leans rotate 2, y -20 over 6s sine.inOut; at 92% it drops to y 700 with rotate -6 (expo.in) and the headline lines exit upward.
adapt: Replace the contact name, message strings, times and the headline; add or remove .msg elements and the cadence follows automatically from the in/out classes. Keep the 0.45s back.out(1.8) pops and the 0.7s typing pause.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the phone and chat from shot.messages, applies the initial autoAlpha/scale set and must read each bubble's offsetTop after layout for the typing indicator; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the phone entry at 0, bubble cadence starting at 0.09D and exit at 0.92D. document.querySelector('.typing') and '.status' must be scoped to el; the textContent tweens are set-like and reverse correctly; from() tweens should be fromTo with immediateRender:false.
caveats: typing indicator position depends on offsetTop measured at mount, so layout must be final first
loop does not close: phone drops off and headline exits
